Suppose that

$$
S={\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{{(-2)}^{n}}{(n+1)!}
$$

and that ${s}_{5}$ is the fifth partial sum of $S.$ According to the alternating series error bound, $|S-{s}_{5}|<k$ for some real number $k.$ Find the value of $k.$ Do not round the answer.
